Name: Barn and Coop Animal Signs
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
Signs that show barn and coop animals. All chickens, cows, goats, ostrich, dinosaurs, rabbits, sheep and pig. There are dark, stone and woods sign for each animal. 

White Chicken
Gold Chicken
Void Chicken
Brown Chicken 
Blue Chicken
White Cow
Brown Cow
Goat
Pig
Sheep 
Ostrich
Dinosaur

Signs can be bought at the traveling cart and/or Marnie's and are available in the furniture catalogue.
